mentions.name: Amber
mentions.description: A Lisp-like language interpreter implemented in Rust, built as a project to gain experience with the language. The entire development process is recorded and published as a YouTube series.
mentions.source_excerpt: To gain more experience with Rust I'm implementing an interpreter for a Lisp-like language in it. As an additional challenge I've committed myself to record the entire development process and put it on YouTube. https://github.com/ema-fox/amber
